_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'ACTIVITY LIST' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-04.03.02.

f01_Activity_Identifier_and_Name.label: Activity Identifier and Name
f01_Activity_Identifier_and_Name.guidance: Unique activity code and concise action-oriented title for each schedule activity.

f02_Activity_Scope_of_Work.label: Activity Scope of Work
f02_Activity_Scope_of_Work.guidance: Specific narrative detailing the discrete scope of work to be performed in this activity.

f03_Planned_Iteration_or_Release.label: Planned Iteration or Release
f03_Planned_Iteration_or_Release.guidance: The target delivery sprint, wave, or milestone window assigned to this activity.

f04_Activity_Execution_Method.label: Activity Execution Method
f04_Activity_Execution_Method.guidance: Technical or managerial execution approach applied to perform the work.

f05_Estimated_Effort_and_Duration_Units.label: Estimated Effort and Duration Units
f05_Estimated_Effort_and_Duration_Units.guidance: Estimated working effort in person-hours and planned calendar duration.

f06_Parent_WBS_Work_Package_Mapping.label: Parent WBS Work Package Mapping
f06_Parent_WBS_Work_Package_Mapping.guidance: The parent WBS work package identifier and deliverable directly decomposed by this activity.

f07_Activity_Completion_Deliverable.label: Activity Completion Deliverable
f07_Activity_Completion_Deliverable.guidance: The tangible or verified intermediate output produced upon activity completion.
